overview: The Committee of the Whole met to receive and discuss a presentation from the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford regarding local arts advocacy and requested municipal support.

items.title: Resolution 26-107: City Support for Arts and Culture
items.summary: Representatives from the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford presented on local arts programming, requesting increased municipal funding and a dedicated arts liaison staff position to coordinate community events. The motion to approve the resolution passed following extensive public comment.
